title: bug(key-value): tz-aware expires_on written, naive datetime.now() compared on read
body:
## What the code does
`AcquireDistributedLockCommand` writes `expires_on` as tz-aware UTC while `KeyValueDAO` and `KeyValueEntry.is_expired` compare against naive `datetime.now()`.

## Intended remediation
Normalise every key-value expiry read/write to tz-aware UTC.

## Verification
`pytest tests/unit_tests/key_value -q`

title: bug(gsheets): outbound POST has no timeout and can hang a worker
body:
## What the code does
`GSheetsEngineSpec._do_post` calls `session.post(...)` with no `timeout`.

## Intended remediation
Pass an explicit timeout sourced from config.

## Verification
`pytest tests/unit_tests/db_engine_specs/test_gsheets.py -q`

title: chore(webdriver): silent except/pass hides browser cleanup failures
body:
## What the code does
`WebDriverPlaywright._cleanup` swallows every exception.

## Intended remediation
Log at warning level, keep non-propagating behaviour.

## Verification
`pytest tests/unit_tests/utils/webdriver_test.py -q`
